snippet.title: Piranha Panic v1.05 (Windows game 1999)
snippet.description:
Piranha Panic is a Swedish game.
The goal is to eat your way through the river in order to reunite your Piranha family.
Several enemy infested lakes must be passed first.
You move the Piranha with the arrow keys and bite with the Ctrl key.
